lines: Yawn! I must have dozed off in the sun.
I had this dream about a Drowzee eating my dream.
What's this? Where did this TM come from? This is spooky!
reward: Here, you can have this TM.

lines: Ah, a challenger finally arrives. I was about to take a nap.
Although I'm the newly appointed Gym Leader of the Kanto region, I was once a leader in Johto. So, this is nothing new to me.
Lance may be considered the world's dragon master, but I'm a close second!
battle: Do you still dare to take me on? Fine, let's do this!
Years of being defeated as a Gym Leader have changed my perspective, although I haven't been humbled like that in a while.
This move strikes fear in its foes. You don't want to miss it.
reward: TM59 contains Dragon Pulse. It's a huge blast of draconicn energy. Teach it to a Dragon-type. Since you're off to the Pokémon League, this may help you.
